components: a small left loop rising into the crown
a large right loop curling inward
strokeOrder: circle the small left loop and climb into the crown
without lifting, sweep through the large right loop and curl inward — then lift once
set the pen at the right of the separate lower bowl, draw it down and around, and return left
strokeOrderNote: two strokes — two joined upper-loop movements, one pen lift, then the separate lower bowl; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Module 14 and Appendix I Frame 14, ஒ

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Module 14, ஒ, with Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 14 (University of Texas at Austin), p. 195
strokeOrderSource.variation: Module 14 identifies ஒ as short o. Appendix I Frame 14 numbers three movements: the left loop and large right loop stay joined, followed by the separate lower bowl after one lift. This two-run learner order is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline; Tamil handwriting varies by school.

notes: Independent short o begins words such as ஒன்று (oṉṟu, one). Frame 14's first two numbered movements form the connected upper body; the lower bowl begins after the single lift.
